def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=[v for v,n in c.items() if n<c[bg]]
    # marker color = the one with most occurrences among non-bg (many markers), stamp color(s) = the rest
    marker=max(colors,key=lambda v:c[v])
    # find sample stamp: connected cells of non-bg non-marker colors
    stamp_color=set(colors)-{marker}
    cells=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v in stamp_color]
    si=[i for i,j in cells]; sj=[j for i,j in cells]
    pi,pj=min(si),min(sj)
    h=w=0
    pat=[[g[pi+a][pj+b] for b in range(max(sj)-min(sj)+1)] for a in range(max(si)-min(si)+1)]
    ph,pw=len(pat),len(pat[0])
    ci,cj=pi+ph//2, pj+pw//2  # marker center offset within stamp
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,r in enumerate(g):
        for j,v in enumerate(r):
            if v==marker:
                for a in range(ph):
                    for b in range(pw):
                        x,y=i+a-ci, j+b-cj
                        if 0<=x<len(out) and 0<=y<len(out[0]):
                            out[x][y]=pat[a][b]
    return out
d={k:[list(r) for r in v] for k,v in G.items()}
r=transform(d['Demo pair 1 input'])
print(r==d['Demo pair 1 output'])
import json
out=transform(d['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(out))
